page.overview:
Who is Nomo?

Nomo has a spiky rosy brown hair with the bangs being slicked up to the back, he has a distinct scar on his right cheek. He wears the general Public Safety Devil hunter uniform.

Nomo is a energetic, easy-going, friendly, and supportive Devil Hunter. He treats Aki well and wishes for him to return to the 2nd Division, he strives to become Vice captain in five years and bring back Aki into their group once all goes well. Aki sees him as a friend and a respectable coworker.

Nomo is also a bit of a jokester, often making witty comments even in the face of danger such as when he commented on wanting to join a mixer with his Vice Captain despite being up against the Bomb Hybrid.

Nomo is first seen at the Anti-Devil 2nd Division's Training Facility, with Aki Hayakawa and others, he is the first person to see the injured Denji and Beam, with Beam warning of the Bomb Devil coming. He sees Reze outside the facility and tells Aki to run away with Denji while he stalls Reze.
